articles.title: Fake staking site drains $8.5 million in XRP from dozens of investors promising easy yield
articles.snippet: Seoul police say the amount of the scam might rise to nearly $20 million. Two alleged scammers were detained and a third remains at-large.

articles.title: Bitcoin analysts agree the Fed's hold was hawkish. They are split on what happens next.
articles.snippet: Four analysts agree the Fed's hawkish hold changes the calculus for risk assets, but they split on whether bitcoin's real test is already here or still six weeks away.

articles.title: South Korea report proposes stablecoin rules before crypto law
articles.snippet: Policy report recommends interim licensing guidance, greater flexibility for stablecoin issuers and rules ahead of the Digital Asset Basic Act.

articles.title: Binance.US to attempt prediction markets entry as CFTC-licensed entity, says CEO
articles.snippet: The CEO of the US crypto exchange said that the company would apply for a license with the CFTC in August, allowing it to offer prediction markets.

articles.title: The 100x obsession: Fundamentals grow in importance as crypto matures
articles.snippet: Crypto’s fundamentals have never been stronger, yet degens keep chasing hot new narratives. Behavioral finance may explain why get-rich-quick stories continue to beat substance.
